notes: Power consumption is stated as < 22.5W. Tx in-band and out-of-band OSNR values are minima per 0.1nm. Application-code Tx power is 0dBm for every mode; the configurable range is -6 to +1dBm. Rx sensitivities are specified at OSNR >35dB. Rx OSNR values are specified at -12dBm receiver power. The application-code 6 sensitivity is printed as --28dBm and represented numerically as -28. CDC ranges are stated at 0.5dB OSNR penalty, but no absolute penalized OSNR value is given, so no penalty object is emitted. Absolute maximum conditions state Rx signal input power +3dBm and Rx total input power +13dBm; these are not identified as operational receiver overload values. Storage temperature is -40°C to +85°C. The 100GHz value describes compatibility with existing 100GHz-spacing ROADM architectures; 6.25GHz is printed with the tunable frequency range.
suggestions: Add fields for inequality qualifiers, storage temperature, absolute maximum receiver powers, per-mode optical specifications, and tuning-grid step versus supported ROADM spacing.
